hooks.name: Impeccable design check after UI edits
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, if that file is part of the React frontend (react-ui/frontend/src), run the Impeccable anti-slop detector on the frontend and fix any findings before finishing the task.

action.prompt: Design check: if the file you just edited is under react-ui/frontend/src (a .tsx, .ts or .css file), run `.kiro/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable detect --json react-ui/frontend/src` from the workspace root before you finish the current task. Exit code 2 means findings. Fix every finding in files you touched (overused fonts, side-tab accent borders, layout-property transitions, contrast, cramped padding, etc.) so the detector reports 0 findings for those files, then re-run it. Do not add detector ignores to make findings go away. If the edited file is not under react-ui/frontend/src, ignore this message.
